THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of Wovemba 21, 2016, by and between 118th STREET RECTORY LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at 312 West 118"h Street, New York, NY 10026 (the "Land Parcel Owner"), and 1871 PARK EQUITIES LLC, (Air Space Parcel Owner"),' a Delaware limited liability company having an address at c/o Artimus Construction, 316 West 118th Street, New York, NY 10026. RECITALS: A.Land Parcel Owner is the owner in fee title of that certain real property which lies below a horizontal plane drawn at a height of 110 feet above the Manhattan Datum (hereinafter defined), located in the Borough of Manhattan in the City and State of New York, within the boundaries of and designated as Tax Lot52 of Block 1923 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map"), as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said real property, the “Land Parcel"; any building or structure now or hereafter located thereon, the “Land Parcel Improvements"; the Land Parcel and the Land Parcel Improvements collectively, the “Land Parcel Premises"); B.Air Space Parcel Owner is the owner in fee title ofthat certain parcel of air space which lies above a horizontal plane drawn at a height of 110 feet above the Manhattan Datum, located within the boundaries of and designated as part of Tax Lot 52 of Block 1923 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said Premises"); C. The Land Parcel and the Air Space Parcel comprise a single Zoning Lot within the meaning of Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, definition of “Zoning Lot” subdivision (a), as evidenced by a Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement of even date herewith and annexed hereto as Exhibit C prior to the date hereof (the “Rectory Zoning Lot"); D.Bursuant to that certainaZoning Lot and Development Declaration_dated the "Developiment Rights Declaration") a c6pybf which is annexed hereto as Exhibit D (i) the Land Parcel has been allocated the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) of seven thousand seven hundred eighteen (7,7i8) square feet of Floor Area attributable to the Rectory Zoning Lot, for use on the Land Parcel by Land Parcel Owner, and (i) the Air Space Parcel has been allocated the remainder of the Floor Area Development Rights attributable to the Rectory Zoning Lot from time to time (such Floor Area the “Air Space Parcel Floor Area"); E.Land Parcel Owner intends to construct or maintain on the Land Parcel Premises a development, which may include a conversion, enlargement, Rebuilding (as hereinafter I Note: All blanks in this document to be filled in by Air Space Parcel Owner prior to recording. 1
